description: A character may normally equip up to two General Artifacts.

artifacts.name: Ring of Accuracy
artifacts.effect: Once per Round, before making an Attack, gain Accurate 1 for that Attack.

artifacts.name: Ring of Fortitude
artifacts.effect: Once per Round, when making Armor Saves, gain Tough 1 for that Save pool.

artifacts.name: Boots of Leaping
artifacts.benefit: Ignore 2" of Difficult Terrain each Move
artifacts.effect: Ignore the first 2" of Difficult Terrain during each Move.

artifacts.name: Cloak of Shadows
artifacts.effect: If you begin the Round outside of Short Range of any enemy, gain Concealed until you Attack or enter Engagement.

artifacts.name: Cloak of Displacement
artifacts.benefit: Improve applicable Evade once per Round
artifacts.effect: Once per Round, when targeted by an Attack against which you may use Evade, improve Evade by 1 step for that Attack.

artifacts.name: Amulet of Warding
artifacts.effect: Choose Physical or Magic when acquiring this Artifact. Gain Ward 6+ against that Attack type.

artifacts.name: Charm of Second Chances
artifacts.benefit: Reroll one die once per Round
artifacts.effect: Once per Round, reroll one die you have rolled. The new result must be kept. A die may only be rerolled once.

command.name: Sound the Advance
command.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within Short Range. Move that Unit up to 2". This movement cannot enter Engagement.

artifacts.name: Banner of Defiance
artifacts.benefit: Nearby allies ignore a temporary penalty
artifacts.effect: Friendly Units within 2" may ignore the first temporary Hit or Move penalty applied to them each Round.

command.name: Borrowed Time
command.effect: Choose yourself or one friendly Unit within Short Range. Increase its Move by 2" until the end of the Round.
